content.title: France defeats Brazil in international friendly at Gillette

I see them all the time on TV, but it will be my first live match,” she said, while her husband cooked crepes on a grill they step in the parking lot. “The whole family is soccer fans. The crowd's support has seemingly swung in Brazil's favor: France's entrance was met with a resounding wave of boos.3:04 pm ET March 26, 2026France to debut Statue of Liberty-inspired kitsCameron MerrittA post on X by the French Football Federation confirmed that Les Bleus will be wearing their new secondary kits, which are a pale green with copper trims, including the club crest.Created for this summer's World Cup, the color scheme is inspired by the Statue of Liberty, which France gifted to the United States in 1886 in celebration of the two nations' connections dating back to the Revolutionary War, America's centennial and the abolition of slavery.2:41 pm ET March 26, 202690 minutes to kick-offJason SnowParking-lot tailgates have roared on all morning and early afternoon, but the gates at Gillette Stadium have now opened. Fans are starting to fill up the stands, awaiting the 4 p.m. start between France and Brazil. The teams will likely come out for warm-ups shortly after the top of the hour.1:30 pm ET March 26, 2026Kylian Mbappé discusses his experience in BostonJason SnowKylian Mbappé is getting his first look at the Boston area. He and France will play Norway in Group I of the World Cup on June 26 at 3 p.m."It's an amazing opportunity to be here, not only about fútbol, but about culture also," Mbappé said during his prematch press conference on March 25. "For many of us, it's the first time we're here in Boston so we know nothing about Boston, nothing about the city. It's important as a person to know a new culture, new city, new people. ... It's an experience of life."Mbappé also previewed Thursday's friendly by saying Brazil is the sport's "best country in the world," adding that it will "be fun for everybody in America to watch to this type of game before the World Cup to give you a first step of what we're going to do this summer."1:00 pm ET March 26, 2026Which World Cup games will be played at Gillette Stadium?Jason SnowGillette Stadium, which will be known as Boston Stadium during play for sponsorship reasons, will host seven games in the upcoming World Cup. Boston is listed as one of 16 host cities in Canada, Mexico and the United States.June 19: Scotland vs. Morocco (Group C), 6 p.m.June 16: FIFA playoff 2 vs. Norway (Group I), 6 p.m.June 13: Haiti vs. Scotland (Group C), 9 p.m.June 23: England vs. Ghana (Group L), 4 p.m.June 26:Norway vs. France (Group I), 3 p.m.June 29: Round of 32, 4:30 p.m.July 9: Quarterfinal, 4 p.m.11:44 am ET March 26, 2026Fans start to gather at Gillette StadiumSam PausmanFans are starting to gather in Foxborough including Reela Elhassen, who came with her husband and two young children. “It’s a historic moment,” Elhassen said outside Gillette. “We flew all the way from Ohio. We don’t live here. This is our first time in Boston; we just came for the game. It’s the titans. Both champions, against each other. The best two teams in the world.” Dressed in a Mbappe jersey, 11-year-old Noah Hall was excited to be at the match. “I watched him on TV in the last World Cup and I was amazed at how he played. My whole family is part French.
